arxiv-2107-09935.title: Quantum cluster kink and ring frustration
arxiv-2107-09935.creator: Zhen-Yu Zheng, Han-Chuan Kou, Peng Li
arxiv-2107-09935.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Zhen-Yu Zheng, Han-Chuan Kou, Peng Li. In this paper, we work on the pure and mixed cluster models with periodic boundary condition. The first purpose is to establish the concept of quantum cluster kink. We clarify that there are two types of cluster kinks since there are two types of ground states depending on the choice of cluster length, of which the first type exhibits symmetry breaking order and the second one string order.

arxiv-2306-06519.title: Phylogenetic network classes through the lens of expanding covers
arxiv-2306-06519.creator: Andrew Francis 1 , Daniele Marchei 1,2 , and Mike Steel 3
arxiv-2306-06519.description: Abstract . It was recently shown that a large class of phylogenetic networks, the ‘labellable’ networks, is in bijection with the set of ‘expanding’ covers of finite sets. In this paper, we show how several prominent classes of phylogenetic networks can be characterised purely in terms of properties of their associated covers.

arxiv-2307-10197.title: Solvable Neural Network Model for Input-Output Associations: Optimal Recall at the Onset of Chaos
arxiv-2307-10197.creator: Tomoki Kurikawa, Kunihiko Kaneko
arxiv-2307-10197.description: Abstract In neural information processing, an input modulates neural dynamics to generate a desired output. To unravel the dynamics and underlying neural connectivity enabling such input-output association, we proposed an exactly soluble neural-network model with a connectivity matrix explicitly consisting of inputs and required outputs.

arxiv-2311-15630.title: Generalized φ \varphi -pullback attractors for evolution processes and application to a nonautonomous wave equation
arxiv-2311-15630.creator: Matheus C. Bortolan, Tomás Caraballo, Carlos Pecorari Neto
arxiv-2311-15630.description: Abstract . In this work we define the generalized φ \varphi -pullback attractors for evolution processes in complete metric spaces, which are compact and positively invariant families, such that they pullback attract bounded sets with a rate determined by a decreasing function φ \varphi that vanishes at infinity.

arxiv-2408-04116.title: Combining Neural Architecture Search and Automatic Code Optimization: A Survey
arxiv-2408-04116.creator: Inas Bachiri, Hadjer Benmeziane, Riyadh Baghdadi, Smail Niar, Hamza Ouarnoughi, Abdelkrime Aries
arxiv-2408-04116.description: Abstract DL ( DL ) models have experienced exponential growth in complexity and resource demands in recent years. Accelerating these models for efficient execution on resource-constrained devices has become more crucial than ever. Two notable techniques employed to achieve this goal are HW-NAS ( HW-NAS ) and ACO ( ACO ).

arxiv-2410-13946.title: Weak Mixing Transformation Which Is Shannon Orbit Equivalent to a Given Ergodic Transformation
arxiv-2410-13946.creator: James O’Quinn
arxiv-2410-13946.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by James O’Quinn. We prove that every ergodic transformation is Shannon orbit equivalent to a weak mixing transformation. The proof is based on the techniques introduced by Fieldsteel and Friedman to show that there is a mixing transformation for a given ergodic transformation T T which is, for all a ≥ 1 a\geq 1 , weak- a a -equivalent to T T and, for all b ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) b\in(0,1) , strong- b b -equivalent to T T .

arxiv-2507-00613.title: Physics-Informed Neural ODEs for Temporal Dynamics Modeling in Cardiac T 1 T_{1} Mapping
arxiv-2507-00613.creator: Nuno Capitão *, Yi Zhang *, Yidong Zhao, Qian Tao
arxiv-2507-00613.description: Abstract Spin-lattice relaxation time ( T 1 T_{1} ) is an important biomarker in cardiac parametric mapping for characterizing myocardial tissue and diagnosing cardiomyopathies. Conventional Modified Look-Locker Inversion Recovery (MOLLI) acquires 11 breath-hold baseline images with interleaved rest periods to ensure mapping accuracy.

arxiv-2602-10618.title: From Interaction to Demonstration Quality in Virtual Reality: Effects of Interaction Modality and Visual Representation on Everyday Tasks
arxiv-2602-10618.creator: Robin Beierling, Manuel Scheibl, Jonas Dech, Abhijit Vyas, Anna-Lisa Vollmer
arxiv-2602-10618.description: Abstract Virtual Reality (VR) is increasingly used for training and demonstration purposes including a variety of applications ranging from robot learning to rehabilitation. However, the choice of input device and its visualization might influence workload and thus user performance leading to suboptimal demonstrations or reduced training effects.

pmc-11336225.title: Adjustment of the marine ecological red lines in China
pmc-11336225.creator: Rong Zeng, Yan Xu, Lu Yang, Yangyi Ai, Jie Liu, Chang Liu, Wenhai Lu
pmc-11336225.description: The marine ecological red lines (MERLs) is an institutional innovation of the Chinese government to seek a balance between ecological protection and social development. China’s MERLs was designated in 2017, but there are problems such as insufficient consideration of areas of high ecological importance and lack of convergence with marine functional zoning.

pmc-11441028.title: Disseminated embolization of an inferior vena cava filter with penetration of the aorta
pmc-11441028.creator: Marcus Brugger, Jochen Gaa, Katharina Bergmann
pmc-11441028.description: a CT angiography was performed at the MVZ Arabellahaus in Munich. This revealed a fractured IVC filter with penetration of the adjacent abdominal aorta and disseminated embolization of fragments into the left renal artery (Panel A), the pulmonary arteries, and the right ventricle (Panel B).

pmc-11505931.title: Recovery and Analysis of Bacterial Membrane Vesicle Nanoparticles from Human Plasma Using Dielectrophoresis
pmc-11505931.creator: Jason P. Ware, Delaney K. Shea, Shelby L. Nicholas, Ella A. Stimson, Jessica L. Riesterer, Stuart D. Ibsen
pmc-11505931.description: Bacterial membrane vesicle (BMV) nanoparticles are secreted naturally by bacteria throughout their lifecycle and are a rich source of biomarkers from the parent bacteria, but they are currently underutilized for clinical diagnostic applications, such as pathogen identification, due to the time-consuming and low-yield nature of traditional recovery methods required for analysis.

pmc-12553856.title: Tomographic assessment of glenoid fossa morphology and position in symmetric and asymmetric patients
pmc-12553856.creator: Arturo Arbelaez-Ramirez, Eduardo Tuta-Quintero, Daniel Botero-Rosas
pmc-12553856.description: ObjectiveTo assess positional and morphological characteristics of the glenoid fossa in patients with and without craniofacial asymmetry using cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT), and to identify structural adaptations associated with temporomandibular joint (TMJ) compensation.MethodsAn observational study analyzed CBCT scans from 47 patients: 36 with facial asymmetry and 11 symmetric controls.

pmc-12579405.title: Localising OCTA changes induced by the isometric hand-grip test to the superficial retina in neovascular age-related macular degeneration
pmc-12579405.creator: Matt Trinh, Yoh Ghen Tee, Judy Nam, Simon Chen, Gary Schiller, Jeff Friedrich, David Ng, Angelica Ly, Chris Hodge, Lisa Nivison-Smith
pmc-12579405.description: PurposeThis study uses optical coherence tomography angiography (OCTA) topographical cluster analysis to localise where vascular changes occur during the isometric hand-grip test (IHGT) in eyes with neovascular age-related macular degeneration (AMD).MethodsThis prospective study included single eyes from 44 participants with neovascular AMD.

pmc-12766403.title: A catalyst for traditional medicine: AI as a scientific, standardized, and regulated bridge
pmc-12766403.creator: Ji-Sheng Han, Haiting Jiang
pmc-12766403.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). His decades of research into the neurobiological mechanisms of acupuncture, which demonstrated its analgesic effects through the release of endogenous opioid peptides, were guided by this very principle. This journey, culminating in the development of the Han's Acupoint Nerve Stimulator (HANS) and the establishment of International Standards Organization (ISO) standards for electroacupuncture,1, 2, 3 proved that traditional therapies can be understood and validated through a scientific framework. Today, artificial intelligence (AI) provides the next logical step in this modernization process.

pmc-12958978.title: Lineages of Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex associated with pulmonary drug-resistant tuberculosis in Africa: a systematic review
pmc-12958978.creator: Cornelius Gweba, Adegboyega Omoniyi Oyefabi, Abimbola Awopeju, Regina Doro Jabaka, Leonard Ighodalo Uzairue
pmc-12958978.description: IntroductionThe emergence of multidrug-resistant tuberculosis has eroded the gains made in the fight against tuberculosis. This review aims to provide current perspectives on the lineages of the Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex (MTBC) associated with drug-resistant tuberculosis (DR-TB) in Africa.MethodPrimary studies were retrieved from PubMed, AJOL, Scopus and Africa Index Medicus databases, including worldwide science and Bielefeld Academic Search Engine websites.

pmc-13415513.creator: Zahra Asadi Qajarloo, Hossein Arfaeinia, Maliheh Jahanara, Amin Safaei, Marjan Jafari, Arefeh Dehghani-tafti, Elham Khalili Sadrabad
pmc-13415513.description: This study investigated the microplastics (MPs) release in chicken sausages before and after packaging for 180 days of storage at -18 °C–4 °C. Samples were digested in 10% KOH at 50 °C, filtered (0.6 μm), and MPs characteristics (color, shape and size) were determined by optical microscope.

pmc-13530201.title: Deep learning for freezing of gait assessment using inertial measurement units: a multicentre validation study
pmc-13530201.creator: Po-Kai Yang, Juha Carlon, Maaike Goris, Emilie Klaver, Jorik Nonnekes, Richard J A van Wezel, Lisa Alcock, Alison J Yarnall, Lynn Rochester, Clint Hansen, Christian Schlenstedt, Walter Maetzler, David Buzaglo, Marina Brozgol, Jeffrey M Hausdorff, Alice Nieuwboer, Moran Gilat, Pieter Ginis, Bart Vanr
pmc-13530201.description: Video annotation is the gold standard for assessing Freezing of Gait (FOG) in Parkinsonian disorders, but it is time-consuming. Deep learning (DL)-based assessment of FOG using inertial measurement units ameliorates this problem but poses challenges. Particularly, the large heterogeneity between patients and assessment methods potentially affects detection performance between independent cohorts.

uslaw-usc-t36-s70108.title: 36 U.S.C. § 70108 — Duty to maintain corporate and tax-exempt status
uslaw-usc-t36-s70108.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s70108.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 701 (Fleet Reserve Association). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Corporate Status.— The corporation shall maintain its status as a corporation incorporated under the laws of Pennsylvania. (b) Tax-Exempt Status.— The corporation shall maintain its status as an organization exempt from taxation under the Internal Revenue.
